title: git-test-repositories says git checkout and git switch skip die_if_checked_out when the main worktree's HEAD is a symref to the branch, but the check reads the current worktree's HEAD
goal: kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md's 'In use is wider' fact says only what builtin/checkout.c's die_if_switching_to_a_branch_in_use at v2.55.0 does: it returns early when the current worktree's HEAD already is the branch (get_main_ref_store reads the current worktree's gitdir; its comment: 'bypassed when the branch is already the current one'), so in a linked worktree a branch held only by the main worktree still dies. Found by the SP-xt4t63xw review (S2, git-test-repositories.md:268).

run: import sys;t=' '.join(open('kb/public/gitlab/git-test-repositories.md',encoding='utf-8').read().split());sys.exit(1 if "also when the main worktree's `HEAD`" in t else 0)

repro_reason: a kb content defect: the text is what a lookup returns
